# CWI Sync — One-Stop Licensing
> One-stop sync licensing for the 24-track That Boy Hi Hat alternative rap catalog — 100% pre-cleared, master + publishing in one agreement.

Inbound licensing funnel for the That Boy Hi Hat catalog. Three one-sheet PDFs (company, artist, Diabolique single), a /license/ inquiry page, and a structured GitHub issue-template inquiry form plus mailto. Inbound only — no outbound solicitation.

## Live
- App: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-sync/
- Try it: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-sync/license

## Features
- 3 one-sheet PDFs (reproducible build via tools/build_one_sheets.py)
- /license/ inquiry funnel page
- Structured GitHub issue-template inquiry form
- mailto:hp@cumulativeweb.com freeform route
- Claim-verification doc tracing every public claim

## Machine-readable
- license: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-sync/license
- company_one_sheet: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-sync/one-sheets/cwi-sync-company-one-sheet.pdf

## Honest limits
Inbound inquiries only. Licensing quotes are issued by CWI — the site never auto-issues licenses.

## Provider
Cumulative Web Inc — hp@cumulativeweb.com
